Additional functions
The platform is equipped with a set of all necessary features to conduct a full sales cycle
Voice and picture recognition
Suvvy AI-Bots understand speech, can search through photos, and are even able to send voice messages on their own. They are just as good as human employees
Sending Follow-Ups to Customers
Suvvy can automatically send additional messages to a customer if they forget to reply to you or cut off communication, bringing them back into the sales funnel
Integration with Google Calendar
Suvvy integration with Google calendar will allow the bot to check availability, suggest them to customers for approval, and automatically fit customer appointments into your schedule.
Employee invitation
The bot can be configured to automatically invite an employee to a dialog based on trigger events

Сhat-Bot Settings
Choice of solutions
You select a ready-made script from the library that is suitable for your business.

The script can be adjusted, or you can create your own
Setting up a knowledge base
You provide the bot with all the necessary information about your business. When communicating with customers, the bot will check the knowledge base to formulate a response
Connecting channels
Integration with Bitrix24, WhatsApp, Telegram and other channels occurs in a couple of clicks. The platform provides detailed instructions and an interface with hints
Testing and launch
You can check the bot’s operation directly in the platform interface. After successful testing, the bot can begin interacting with customers in real time.
Ready-made solutions for your tasks
Suvvy is not just a chatbot, but a smart AI employee capable of working according to pre-configured communication scenarios. This setup allows you to adapt the bot to specific tasks and unique processes of your business.
Initial setup takes 5-15 minutes.
